srList.sentence: Hypertension Definition The diagnosis of hypertension was made based on BP > 13080 on two separate office visits or previous treatment with antihypertensive drugs according to the American College of Cardiology (ACC) and the American Heart Association (AHA) guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults.
